title: Accessibility certification evidence and focus/contrast hardening for compact controls
creator: Marcel Ng
description:
Scope: consolidate evidence and implement targeted fixes across compact UI tokens, primary/secondary button styles, virtualized tables, and small-form-factor charts. Deliver a packaged accessibility certification artifact (VPAT-style evidence set) plus a small rollout of token changes and component adjustments that improves keyboard navigation, restores predictable focus order, and brings key contrast ratios to WCAG AA+ where feasible without breaking density requirements.

Objectives:
- Produce a reproducible test-suite and evidence pack for compliance reviewers covering keyboard flows, screen reader scenarios, and color contrast.
- Harden focus styles for compact controls (thin density chips, pill actions, table row actions) to be visible in high-contrast and dark themes without increasing perceived visual density.
- Rework keyboard mappings for nested table actions and chart interactive legends to avoid focus traps and support roving tabindex where necessary.
- Audit chart ARIA landmarks and live-region announcements for streaming data and provide remediation patterns.
- Provide a migration plan for token updates with a compatibility layer for consumers and a canary rollout path in Console.

Deliverables:
1) Accessibility evidence pack (screenshots, recorded NVDA/VoiceOver runs, test scripts).
2) Token delta RFC and upgrade notes for developers.
3) Design specs (Figma) for focus rings, contrast ramps, and updated component anatomy.
4) PRs for component library with unit + e2e accessibility tests.
5) Rollout checklist for staged deployment and post-release monitoring metrics.
acceptance_criteria: All modified components have automated a11y checks in CI (axe-core or equivalent) and pass on major themes
Focus indicators meet 3:1 minimum contrast against adjacent background for compact controls; primary action meets WCAG AA text contrast where label size requires
Keyboard flows for nested table actions and chart legends verified with NVDA and VoiceOver; documented fallback patterns provided
VPAT-style evidence pack includes screenshots, narrative test steps, test results, and links to PRs/fixtures
Token migration path documented and libraries include feature-flagged rollout for Console customers
comments: 2025-02-14 Marcel Ng: Created ticket after cross-team sync with SRE and Platform Security. Initial scope prioritized by customer requests from enterprise audit (FinanceCorp).

2025-02-18 Aisha Patel: Ran discovery audit across ~45 components. Top offenders: compact chip focus is visually lost in dark-high-contrast, table row action focus order inconsistent under virtualization, chart tooltip dismiss not announced by screen readers. Added labels and initial priority mapping.

2025-02-21 Design review: Decided to standardize on two focus treatments (dense-focus and roomy-focus) and author token variables: token.focusRingWidth-{dense,roomy} + token.focusRingColor-{theme-aware}. Will keep density opt-in for legacy consumers.

notes_for_engineering: Implementation constraints: keep CSS variable names backward-compatible (do not delete token.* aliases). Provide both outline-based and box-shadow fallback for focus indicators to support older browsers. For table virtualization, prefer roving tabindex model over tabindex="-1" toggles where possible to avoid race conditions with recycling rows. Include an opt-out data attribute data-a11y-compact-disable for legacy customers if an immediate upgrade is unsafe.
